sources.title: On the Testability of the Anchor-Words Assumption in Topic Models
sources.snippet: Topic models are a simple and popular tool for the statistical analysis of textual data. Their identification and estimation is typically enabled by assuming the existence of anchor words; that is, words that are exclusive to specific topics.
